COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.

4. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.

7. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.

8. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.

9. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.

10. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

11. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer set up and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
